meta.name: init-first-agent
meta.description: Walk the operator through wiring the first NanoClaw agent to a DM channel — resolve the operator's channel identity, select or create the agent, and trigger a welcome DM via the normal delivery path. Use after channel credentials are configured and the service is running.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把首个智能体接入私信频道并发出欢迎消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你刚布置好智能体服务,想快速接通私信频道。
copy.tagline_en: Connect your first agent to a DM channel and send a welcome message
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you've just set up an agent service and want to quickly wire it to a DM channel.

howto.what: 引导操作员完成第一个 NanoClaw agent 的接入：先选频道、确认操作员在频道里的身份，再创建 agent 并通过正常投递路径发一条欢迎私信，最后确认私信是否送达。
howto.when: 在频道凭据已配置且服务运行后，需要给频道创建第一个 agent 并验证欢迎私信送达时触发。

say.text: 帮我初始化第一个 NanoClaw agent，频道用 Telegram
say.note: 会引导你提供身份信息并创建 agent

say.text: 在 Slack 上创建第一个 agent，发欢迎私信
say.note: 会询问你的频道身份并运行初始化脚本

say.text: 初始化 agent，用 WhatsApp，显示名李四
say.note: 按提示提供身份后创建并发送欢迎消息

howto.what_en: Walks the operator through wiring the first NanoClaw agent: pick a channel, confirm the operator's identity on that channel, create the agent, and trigger a welcome DM via the normal delivery path, then confirm receipt.
howto.when_en: Use after channel credentials are configured and the service is running, when you need to create the first agent for a channel and verify the welcome DM arrives.

say_en.text: Initialize my first NanoClaw agent, channel Telegram
say_en.note: Guides you to provide identity and create the agent

say_en.text: Create the first agent on Slack and send a welcome DM
say_en.note: Asks for your channel identity and runs the init script

say_en.text: Init agent, use WhatsApp, display name Li Si
say_en.note: Provide identity as prompted, then create and send welcome
